nodes.label: Brute force limits (per-IP + global cap)
nodes.rationale: Single admin account, so a distributed guesser is capped globally too.

nodes.label: Computed booth status (booths/status.ts)
nodes.rationale: Computed from last heartbeat so it can never be stale.

nodes.label: No Redis, no Turborepo; Postgres-backed queue
nodes.norm_label: no redis, no turborepo; postgres-backed queue
nodes.rationale: pnpm workspaces are enough for two apps.

nodes.label: One image, two processes (infra/start.mjs)
nodes.rationale: One image, one port: simple to deploy and proxy; container exits if either process dies.

nodes.label: Same origin for web and API (Next /api rewrite)
nodes.norm_label: same origin for web and api (next /api rewrite)
nodes.rationale: Cookies stay first-party and no CORS; Socket.IO works through the same rewrite.

nodes.label: Printing via CUPS / Windows Print Spooler
nodes.norm_label: printing via cups / windows print spooler
nodes.rationale: Print id = kiosk session id so retries never print twice; mid-hand-off jobs are failed not resent.

nodes.label: Shader-glass design
nodes.rationale: Replaces Tailwind + shadcn/ui to avoid running two styling systems; every WebGL layer optional with CSS fallback.

nodes.label: TypeScript 6.0.3 (7.x not adopted)
nodes.rationale: Decorator metadata support unverified in 7.x native compiler.

nodes.label: Visual language adapted from portmap
nodes.rationale: paper-design/liquid-logo (PolyForm Shield) is not used; only the Apache-2.0 shader package; liquid-glass look borrowed in CSS only.

nodes.norm_label: event photo design (strip, grid, one photo)

nodes.label: Photo storage (Cloudflare R2 private bucket)
nodes.rationale: Browsers never get bucket keys; uploads use 10-minute signed links bound to size and SHA-256.

nodes.norm_label: self-service data model (package, payment, voucherbatch, voucher)

nodes.label: QR payment via PayMongo (QR Ph) with webhook
nodes.norm_label: qr payment via paymongo (qr ph) with webhook
nodes.rationale: Price always comes from the server; webhooks signature-verified and idempotent.

nodes.label: Current deployment (Stravex staging, Veldora Caddy, GHCR image)
nodes.norm_label: current deployment (stravex staging, veldora caddy, ghcr image)

nodes.label: Dependency audit (effect fixed, minimatch accepted)
nodes.rationale: minimatch only reachable with attacker-supplied globs; ZIP export never globs.

nodes.label: Offline operation (internet drops)
nodes.rationale: Guests keep going: sessions/photos written to IndexedDB first, delivered in order with reused IDs so nothing is duplicated.
